text: Decision: align. Landed on main as ec8e766 + d68f6fe; the second commit fixes fresh-context review findings. SvgWidget: a pan drag is one entry from press to release. Escape, pointercancel, lostpointercapture and blur keep the reached window as that entry and abandon pinches the same way. A recorded change first draws a waiting frame inside the open run. Extra fingers no longer split a pinch. restore refuses undrawable viewports with SnapshotError.Invalid before changing anything; out-of-bounds viewports are drawn shifted and recorded as drawn. Shared package-private NavigationRun and DataWindowNavigator.windowOf/drawable are used by both hosts. JavaFX also now commits a pinch on focus loss and Escape; covered only by the browser gate and review, not a JavaFX unit test. The JavaFX 'Differences from the browser widget' section is removed. Parity flake root-caused: CDP sends one touch event per moved finger, which sometimes isn't coalesced; reproduced deterministically at the base too. Fix: the parity gate collapses consecutive ViewportChanged:Pointer entries. Evidence: check-history-browser 14 checks on svg+canvas exit 0, negative control fails on the old widget; check-browser-suites.py 15/15 at ec56eb1 (same tree as main bar .mote); traces re-recorded with only digest lines moved. Gates at d68f6fe: testAll 17/17 (2416 tests, 0 failures), check-docs 0 errors, check-compatibility pass, check-fulllink pass.
